text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1m decisions, after Upbit moves up and Coinone has not followed (upbit_lead_impulse) or Coinone trades at an unusually large discount to Upbit vs its own causal rolling basis (venue_gap_revert), Coinone forward returns over 5-30 min exceed a matched (KST hour x volatility) null, net of coinone_conservative cost.
rationale: Mechanism M1 (research/knowledge/mechanisms.md): KRW price discovery happens on Upbit (largest KRW book); Coinone (~5-20% of Upbit KRW volume in Dev, declining) quotes are refreshed late. Counterparty: slow Coinone participants whose stale limit orders get lifted (manual/slow retail limit orders, lagging market makers). Persistence: Coinone is too small for large arbs and before the 0% fee event the lag was smaller than fees. Kills it: Coinone bot flow already arbing (venues.md V-1), fee event end (B grade), our 1m latency, stale Coinone last-trade prices that are not executable. Evidence: Dev data audit (lockbox none, Val none): Upbit(t-1)->Coinone(t) 1m corr 0.06-0.12, stronger 2024-25; Coinone-Upbit gap negatively skewed, drifting level (needs causal baseline). K-P0-5 Binance->Upbit lead is lockbox+Val exposed: motivation only, not used for grid. Data caveats: Coinone zero-volume bars are filled (no entry); filter session_kst all_but_quiet removes KST 03-08 thin hours (audit recommends excluding 02-07; closest available block value); 2023-07..10 thin months cannot be excluded by the tool and are reported as a caveat; entries need both venues' bars (block returns False on missing Upbit bars). Grid uses block-grid values only, not tuned.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs (incl. prior screens), n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (5/15/30 min).

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 5m decisions, after Upbit rises by thr_bp over k 5m bars while Coinone lags by at least half of it (upbit_lead_impulse), Coinone forward returns over 30-120 min exceed a matched (KST hour x volatility) null, net of coinone_conservative cost.
rationale: Same mechanism M1 as the 1m screen (Upbit leads KRW price discovery, Coinone lags); this variant tests whether the information survives a 5m decision interval, which is robust to our own latency and to stale 1m Coinone prints and has a longer horizon that matches the pipeline's lower-turnover detection range (research/reports/pipeline_calibration.md). Counterparty: slow Coinone limit orders / lagging makers. Kills it: lag shorter than 5 min (information already absorbed at the decision), Coinone bots arbitraging. Evidence: Dev data audit 5m Coinone/Upbit return corr 0.82-0.93 (lockbox none, Val none) leaves room for a lag residual; K-P0-5 (lockbox+Val exposed) motivation only. Filter session_kst all_but_quiet (thin KST 03-08 removed). Block-grid values only.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over family screen configs (incl. the 1m screen), n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (30/60/120 min).

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 5m decisions, upside channel breakouts (donchian_breakout, atr_channel_breakout) are followed by 30-120 min returns above a matched (KST hour x volatility) null, and more so when short-term realised volatility is in the upper part of its trailing 7-day range (vol_regime) or in the KST night session.
rationale: Mechanism M3 (mechanisms.md): volatility clustering + stop-loss / short-liquidation cascades + late trend followers make large moves persist briefly (ultra-short time-series momentum). Counterparty: stop orders and liquidated shorts resting above the channel (price-insensitive buyers we front-run), late retail chasers we sell to, counter-trend limit sellers. Persistence: forced liquidations in levered markets execute regardless of price. Kills it: false breakouts in low-vol regimes, costs, 2022-style bear market (long only). Evidence: K-P0-3/K-P0-4 (session, vol tercile) are lockbox+Val exposed: they motivate the filters only; filter values are default block-grid points (vol_regime min_pct 0.67 window 24, session night), not tuned. The matched null stratifies on hour x volatility so filter effects themselves are not counted as signal. Vol computed on Coinone 5m returns (audit: >=5m features acceptable).
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs, n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (30/60/120 min).

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 5m decisions, sharp downside dislocations (close far below its rolling mean: bollinger_z_revert; RSI crossing back up from oversold: rsi_oversold_bounce) are followed by 30-120 min returns above a matched (KST hour x volatility) null, at least when the 1h trend is up (trend_regime_1h).
rationale: Mechanism M4 (mechanisms.md): derivative liquidations and panic selling create price-insensitive spot selling pressure; once it ends, liquidity providers are paid by a partial rebound. Counterparty: force-liquidated levered longs and panic-selling retail. Persistence: they sell regardless of price; liquidity provision during cascades carries inventory risk most participants avoid. Kills it: information-driven drops (no rebound), second-wave cascades (falling knife), bear regimes - the trend_regime_1h filter tests the 'dip in an uptrend' version. Volume confirmation is NOT used because Coinone volume is contaminated/thin (pitfalls P-D1, data audit) and no Upbit-volume block exists. OUTLIER_DEPENDENT risk high (few crash days, e.g. 2024-12-03 martial-law dislocation) - must be checked by robustness if anything passes. No lockbox/Val-exposed evidence used; block-grid values only.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs, n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (30/60/120 min).

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1h decisions, upside breakouts of multi-day highs (donchian_breakout 24/48/144 h), ATR-channel breakouts and persistent positive EMA slope (ema_slope span 48) are followed by 4-24 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost; optionally only in high short-term vol (vol_regime 0.67) or above the 1-week EMA (trend_regime_1h 168).
rationale: Mechanism M3 (mechanisms.md) extended to multi-hour horizons: volatility clustering plus slow information diffusion and trend-following flows (CTA/retail momentum chasing, stop and short-liquidation cascades on derivatives venues spilling into KRW spot) make multi-day highs and persistent EMA slopes continue over 4-24 h (time-series momentum). Counterparty: stop orders and liquidated shorts at breakout levels, counter-trend limit sellers who fade new highs, and late retail chasers we sell to on exit. Why it persists: forced liquidations are price-insensitive; trend capacity at hours horizon is large and crowded-out by nobody on a minor KRW venue. Kills it: long-only spot in bear regimes (2022), false breakouts in low vol, regime beta masquerading as signal (pitfall P-S6) - the matched (KST hour x vol) null removes unconditional drift only within the eligible pool. 5m version (camp-000003/6) was information-thin at 15-30 min (fact-000003, fact-000006, int-000004); re-examine condition 'decision interval changes' is met (15m/1h/4h engine added 2026-11-09). Filters: vol_regime(24,0.67) tests the M3 high-vol story; trend_regime_1h(168) (1-week EMA) is the regime-filtered-trend variant (hypothesis c). Evidence exposure: fact-000003/6 Dev only (lockbox none, Val none); K-P0-4 (lockbox+Val exposed) motivates the vol filter only, its value is the block default/grid value, not derived from it. Scope: Coinone BTC-KRW, decision 1h (and 4h screen), coinone_conservative primary cost, upbit_conservative grade cost; long only. [derived-from drv-000004 ← fact-000006; family vol_breakout]
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs (incl. prior family screens), n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (bar-minute preset). Reported, not gating: upbit_conservative net (grade A/B) and per-year excess (pre-registered side calculation).

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 15m decisions, closes far below the rolling mean (bollinger_z_revert window 24/96, z 2.5) are followed by 1-4 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost, with and without a 1h trend filter (trend_regime_1h 24) or a 1-week bull-regime filter (trend_regime_1h 168), and the excess is not concentrated in one Dev year.
rationale: Mechanism M4 (mechanisms.md): forced liquidations / panic selling push KRW spot below fair value and partially rebound once the price-insensitive flow ends. Counterparty: force-liquidated levered longs and panic-selling retail; liquidity provision during cascades carries inventory risk most participants avoid. Kills it: information-driven drops, second-wave cascades, bear regimes. This re-examines the family at 15m/1h decisions (re-examine condition 'decision interval changes' in fact-000005/fact-000008) and explicitly tests int-000005 (unverified): that the 5m trend-filtered reversion is bull-regime dip buying concentrated in 2021 rather than liquidity-provision income. trend_regime_1h(168) (1-week EMA) is a slow bull-regime filter: the matched null is drawn from the same filtered pool, so a filter-only (regime beta) effect does not count as signal. Pre-registered diagnostic (side calculation, no ledger): for every passing config, per-calendar-year excess at the best primary horizon; int-000005 is supported at this timeframe if the excess is positive in fewer than 3 of the 5 Dev years or one year carries > 50% of the summed excess. Evidence exposure: fact-000004/5/8 and the camp-000008 ad-hoc robustness are Dev only (lockbox none, Val none). Scope: Coinone BTC-KRW, decision 15m and 1h, coinone_conservative primary, upbit_conservative grade; long only. [derived-from drv-000006 ← fact-000008; family liq_meanrev]
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs (incl. prior family screens), n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (bar-minute preset).
